title: Knowledge plane construction method and system based on ensemble learning and federated learning

pse.problem: Limitation in DDOS attack detection accuracy and robustness due to relying on a single detection model
pse.solution_function: Trains an initial DDOS flow identification classification model using federal learning, then aggregates multiple final DDOS flow identification classification models through integrated learning (specifically stacked generalization algorithm) to create a DDOS knowledge plane that improves the accuracy of DDOS attack detection and robustness of the model.
pse.solution_structure: Historical flow log information, primary threat information, multiple initial DDOS flow identification classification models, data set, federal learning results, integrated learning result
pse.solution_implementation: Acquiring historical flow log information and classifying it to label as primary threat information, preprocessing primary threat information to create a data set, performing federal learning on the multiple initial DDOS flow identification classification models using the data set to obtain final models, integrating the final models through stacked generalization algorithm to produce the DDOS knowledge plane
pse.effect: Improved accuracy of DDOS attack detection and robustness of the model
